name: Unaligned Fan-In
description: Joins streams whose records arrive without shared event-time alignment. Combines records based on key equality and arrival proximity, using a sliding buffer rather than strict window boundaries. Tolerates skew and out-of-order arrival.
when_to_use: Upstream sources lack synchronized clocks or watermarks
High skew between streams makes time-alignment impractical
benefits: Robust to clock skew and out-of-order events
Lower coordination overhead than aligned joins
drawbacks: Approximate — may miss or duplicate matches
Buffer size must be tuned per workload
use_cases: Cross-system entity resolution without shared IDs
